items.description: In this dystopian nightmare, soldiers track the Anomaly—a shape-shifting enigma that clones itself, warps reality, and mimics human speech. Communicate with your squad, queue up for online missions, but remember: it’s not just a hunt; it’s a frantic race against time.Soldiers:Soldiers are hunters. They were forged with steel for one purpose: to hunt down anomalies. They hold powerful guns inside their bodies that have insane force to penetrate anything that comes their way alone. The extra weight makes them slower and unable to jump, but the powerful gunshots can easily be heard, and can smash through objects like butter. They cannot be harmed, and only the time limit before the Anomaly escapes can stop them. They can use voice chat to speak to each other if they are close by.Anomaly:Their origins are unknown. Motives unknown. Anomalies can change shape, preferring smaller objects compared to bigger. It can mimic the human voice. It can create false objects, that, when shot, will create a giant puff of smoke, allowing for easier movement. It has the ability to spit, which will temporarily blind a solder for a couple of seconds when hit. It's spit shot can also impact objects, and the bigger the Anomaly's form, the bigger the force it has. But the smaller it is, the faster it becomes. It is easy to learn the basics, but it has a lot of depth to master.Online play:Missions are started with a simple press of a couple of buttons, use the "Join Server" browser to discover missions to join or set them up yourself with "Host Game." Choose what map and how many players you want for a max number to join. Will you infiltrate a haunted graveyard or explore a derelict spaceship? 10 missions to choose from, each with their own quirks to set them apart. Play by yourself when joining a session or have your friends join your session from its session ID. Online play is designed to not show certain info, allowing no advantage to any player outside with pure gameplay skills and manipulation. Physics:Every map has most objects being able to be manipulated by soldiers and the anomaly, making it either easier or harder to win depending on who plays the smartest with what is provided. Change the shape of a map to make each one more dynamic than the last. Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame? items.description: In this epic turn-based multiplayer board game adventure with Strife Lords! Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes, commanding footmen, spearmen, and a powerful king. Capture farm and mine tiles for gold, control major sites, and outmaneuver your rivals. Strategize to become the ultimate Strife Lord.In Strife Lords, you must make a strategy to maintain your army and control the board. Capture farm and mine tiles to amass gold, essential for fueling your conquests, as you can't go on the offensive without paying your units off. Footmen are the weakest, but in groups of 3s will be effective in battle. Spearmen are more aggressive, but they have a weaker time on the defensive. Kings are the strongest unit of the time, being strong in offense and defense. They will all die the same ways in battles, if the battle doesn't go your way. Roll the dice to see how many units you placed in a battle will die, and suffer the consequences. As you navigate the board, form alliances, betray rivals, and outmaneuver your opponents in a quest for dominance over the three main sites to win the game. Will you be aggressive? Or will you slowly chip away at your enemy's units until they have nothing left? There are many different strategies to win. But all that matters is who controls the vital tiles for victory.Key Features:Multiplayer Modes: Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes for diverse gameplay experiences with online play.Objective-Based Gameplay: Control all three major sites on the board to achieve victory. But how you get there, and what you sacrifice to get there is up to you.Resource Management: Capture farm and mine tiles to generate gold for your conquests. Units eat up food when you have it when moving, and battles use up fresh steel. Not using those resources will generate gold over time.Strategic Depth: Form alliances, betray rivals, and outmaneuver opponents in a constantly evolving game.Graphics: Cell shaded graphics and vibrant 3D models that are good to look at while thinking about your next move.Music: 2 main tracks to set the mood for you and your opponents.Perfect for Game Nights: Ideal for friendly competition with online matches. items.description: Your sight is limited in this first-person psychological horror game in the deep abyss. Use sound to your advantage, while you still have your mind in this experience of pure mind-numbing terror. Try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets... if you can...Synopsis:You are in the Abyss, a fountain of sorts. One where you are drowning deeper and deeper. You keep waking up in a room full of couches and a door to the unknown. You hold a book of the past that always resets over and over again. The monsters are dead set on bringing you back. Maybe more, but you cannot remember anything that happens once blacked out by them. Others are trying to contact you, but can you really trust them? The abyss shifts like the sea, but there is only one thing you remember. There is an outside, freedom. The portals. The portals are the key. Find the portals, and reclaim your freedom.Features:Navigate through a dark, evil abyss where your sight is severely restricted. Rely on sound to guide your way and detect lurking beasts. Sound is the key to survival, and it will be used against you. (Headphones are highly recommended!)Use the inventory system to gather and use items to do basic things like opening doors and solving puzzles across multiple areas.There are 6 total monsters with unique behaviors with different ways to avoid their gazes and attacks. The Abyss shifts slightly enough to catch you off guard after every major step and setback, sometimes very slightly or in major ways. Get captured, and get sent back to the start in a cycle of drowning more and more into the abyss's darkness.Every step forward reveals more about how to better survive and get further to reach the surface, along with who you are.Warning:The visuals may be harmful with those with certain conditions. items.description: Tales of Valkyrie follows the perilous descent of two young women—Princess Lenneth and the witch Jelanda—into the demon realm. At its core, it’s a story about loyalty, trust, and the kind of friendship that refuses to break even when everything else does.Lenneth, princess of Artolia, is dragged into a brutal struggle for the throne, forced to clash with her own siblings. Her quest to claim the Demon King’s heart is lined with danger after danger, every step threatening to snap the thin thread her life hangs on.In her darkest moments, Jelanda appears—unyielding, ever-present, and unwilling to let Lenneth face the abyss alone. But can genuine friendship endure when the road is nothing but thorns? What horrors lurk in the demon lands? And can mere humans stand against the creatures that rule that world?More than a typical story-driven adventure, this is where action collides with reflection. Carve through the monstrous fiends that plague the realm, meet allies along the way, and forge your own distinct combat style. Collect relics, rare artifacts, and eccentric gear in this classic turn-based RPG experience.
